$comment: Design Engineering Toolkit converter family — SourceReview. Major version 1. Materialized at the Structural Mapping gate (issue #14 G2). The every-node accountability ledger for one extracted design subtree: for EACH inventoried node it records the combined-evidence semantic classification and one of the closed dispositions, so nothing is silently omitted, dropped or mapped without review. Classification is derived from combined ancestry + node kind + layout + naming hints + capability evidence — a name prefix is a strong hint, never sufficient proof alone.
title: Design Engineering Toolkit — SourceReview (accountability report)

source.description: Design-source revision; must equal the pinned NodeIR's source revision.

nodeIrContentHash.description: STABLE content hash of the exact NodeIR payload this review accounts for: SHA-256 over canonical JSON with ALL observation timestamps removed — re-extraction of the same source revision reproduces it.

total.description: Must equal the pinned NodeIR's node count — every inventoried node is accounted for exactly once.

entries.description: Exactly one entry per NodeIR node. Sorted by nodeId.

diagnostics.description: Review-level findings in canonical diagnostic order.

semanticClass.description: Closed enum. SITE_CHROME = shared theme-owned chrome (excluded from the CMS plan, retained here with its source ref). Site chrome is distinguished from page-local editorial content by combined evidence — a label like 'Footer' alone never decides.

disposition.description: Closed enum; exactly one per node — no silent omission.

reason.description: One actionable sentence naming the evidence behind the classification/disposition decision.

nameHint.description: The naming-convention signal used (e.g. a SITE/ or DECOR/ label prefix), recorded because it was weighed as a hint — never as the sole proof.

sectionId.description: The PageStructure section this node belongs to (present for MAPPED nodes inside a planned section).

category.description: Reuses the registry capability category vocabulary verbatim. 'custom-required' marks a source component with no proven target; 'chrome' marks theme-owned surfaces.

requiresRuntimeData.description: true = the matched capability's dataContext requires runtime data: content is data-provider-backed (DATA_PROVIDER_PENDING), never fabricated.

capabilityIds.description: Registry capability ids actually matched (sorted, unique) — only from a pinned registry, never invented.

provisionalTarget.description: Capability-evidence outcome for this node, when a pinned registry/binding map was supplied.
